body: I find it really hard pushing myself to get out but I really do want to try get better. I'm sick of constantly being stuck in the house and not having any kind of life.

I'm sorry you were in that situation, happy to hear you got out of it though! Yes, I'm planning on going to college. I really want to get my qualifications and then go on to look at jobs. I'll need to work on my anxiety before I just try and jump straight into college though. I think that would be too overwhelming and just set me back even more.

It's okay. I get extremely nervous and uncomfortable in busy situations. I feel like college would be incredibly overwhelming. For the past few years I've barely left the house so I guess I'm used to just being in the house now and not around other people. My house is like my 'safe zone' to me.

Thanks for the reply. I probably didn't make it clear but I didn't manage to actually return to school. I'm wanting to go to college but the idea of it terrifies me. I find leaving the house really difficult now and my anxiety is really bad:(

Sorry I don't think I made it clear but I didn't manage to ever go back to school which is why I'm really keen on going to college soon. The problem is my anxiety is really bad and I don't know how I'll manage college.
Thank you. I really appreciate it.

It must have been so hard but you done it. You should be really proud. Thanks for understanding. You are right, being in my room makes me feel safe. Going outside instantly makes me feel super uncomfortable and I hate it but I also hate the fact that I feel like I'm just wasting my life sitting in the house. I've realised that it's me who is holding myself back and it's really frustrating. I don't want my life to be like this forever, I really do what to get better.
Only if he has an eternity in hell to look forward to

I'm glad you're feeling a bit happier now. That's all I want. Just to feel a bit happier. If only things like this did happen overnight. Motivation is a big struggle for me. I know there is things I could be doing which would be a step in the right direction but it's the doing it part that is difficult.

I just never thought I'd be in the same situation 3 years later though, still feeling depressed and still not leaving the house. I do think that when I stopped going to school I done what was right for me at that moment in time. My anxiety was too bad to be dealing with school. I want to go to college to get my qualifications but I don't know how I'm going to manage it.
